title: Employee Contracts — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The employee's employment contracts and the periods they cover. Saving a contract does not close an earlier one; periods for the same employee cannot overlap, and no two can start on the same date.

For leave types that accrue over the whole employment, the accrual period runs from the joining date to the end date of the employee's latest contract.

fields.label: ContractType
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Contract Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of contract.

Example. Limited — 2 years

Why it matters. Shown on contract and employee reports.
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under General Master Info → Contract Types.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee. No two records for the same employee can start on the same date.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.
